use_case: Use the request form during residential pest-control service and treatment record when the pest control record must identify target pest, structures, rooms, exterior zones, occupants, children, animals, sensitivities, and prior activity. Complete the applicable handoff for treatment record, safety instructions, reentry acknowledgment, monitoring plan, corrective recommendations, and follow-up.
